articles.title: México suspende importação de frango do Brasil após foco da doença de Newcastle em SC | G1
articles.standfirst: Autoridades afirmam que a doença não representa risco significativo para humanos e que o consumo de produtos inspecionados segue seguro.
articles.summary: Autoridades afirmam que a doença não representa risco significativo para humanos e que o consumo de produtos inspecionados segue seguro.
articles.body:
O México suspendeu nesta segunda-feira (19) a importação de carne de frango e de outros produtos avícolas brasileiros após a confirmação de um foco da doença de Newcastle em uma granja comercial de perus em Santa Catarina.

A restrição foi anunciada pela Secretaria de Agricultura e Desenvolvimento Rural do México, que informou que a medida também vale para aves vivas e ovos férteis. Segundo o governo mexicano, a suspensão busca proteger a produção avícola do país, que é considerado livre da doença.

O foco foi confirmado pelo Ministério da Agricultura em uma granja de perus de Nova Itaberaba, no Oeste de Santa Catarina. A propriedade, que abriga cerca de 6 mil animais, foi interditada, e as autoridades iniciaram ações para eliminar o vírus e monitorar outros estabelecimentos da região.

Em nota, o ministério informou que a movimentação de aves foi suspensa no local e que as medidas de contenção e erradicação seguirão o Plano de Contingência para Influenza Aviária e Doença de Newcastle. O caso será comunicado à Organização Mundial de Saúde Animal (OMSA) e aos parceiros comerciais do Brasil.

A doença de Newcastle é uma infecção viral altamente contagiosa entre aves. Segundo a Organização Mundial de Saúde Animal, ela pode provocar problemas respiratórios e neurológicos, queda na produção de ovos e alta mortalidade nos plantéis. As autoridades afirmam que a doença não representa risco significativo para a saúde humana.

O Ministério da Agricultura e a Companhia Integrada de Desenvolvimento Agrícola de Santa Catarina (Cidasc) reforçaram que o consumo de carne de aves e ovos provenientes de estabelecimentos inspecionados continua seguro. Os órgãos destacam que a ocorrência está relacionada à sanidade animal e não à segurança dos alimentos.

Entidades do setor avícola afirmaram que acompanham o caso e ressaltaram que a detecção do vírus na granja não altera a segurança dos produtos destinados ao consumo.

O Brasil é o maior exportador mundial de carne de frango, e a confirmação do foco levou o governo brasileiro a informar o caso aos países importadores, entre eles o México, um dos mercados compradores dos produtos avícolas brasileiros.

Criação de perus - imagem ilustrativa — Foto: Ernesto de Souza/Ed. Globo

A DNC é uma enfermidade viral que contamina aves domésticas e silvestres. Ela é causada pelo vírus pertencente ao grupo paramixovírus aviário sorotipo 1 (APMV-1). Com isso, as aves apresentam sinais respiratórios, seguidos por manifestações nervosas, diarreia e edema da cabeça.

A doença é transmitida por aves migratórias infectadas que fazem rotas comuns através dos continentes. Por conta disso, elas podem ter ocorrência em qualquer lugar do mundo.

A doença pode causar, no máximo, conjuntivite transitória em humanos, podendo durar cerca de uma semana. A transmissão ocorre pelo contato, e não pelo consumo.

articles.title: Justiça do RJ aprova fim de recuperação judicial da Americanas | G1
articles.standfirst: Processo foi iniciado em janeiro de 2023 após revelação de esquema bilionário de fraudes contábeis.
articles.summary: Processo foi iniciado em janeiro de 2023 após revelação de esquema bilionário de fraudes contábeis.
articles.body:
Clientes fizeram fila na frente das Lojas Americanas, no Salvador Shopping — Foto: Divulgação

A Americanas anunciou nesta segunda-feira (19) que a Justiça do Rio de Janeiro decretou o fim do processo de recuperação judicial da empresa, iniciado em janeiro de 2023 após a revelação de um esquema bilionário de fraudes contábeis.

Em comunicado, a Americanas afirmou que cumpriu integralmente as metas do plano aprovado por 91% dos credores.

A empresa afirmou ter registrado, no primeiro semestre de 2026, um avanço de 9,3% nas vendas nas mesmas lojas e um incremento de R$ 500 milhões na eficiência operacional.

O encerramento do processo de recuperação judicial atende a um pedido feito pela companhia em março deste ano . A decisão foi tomada pela 4ª Vara Empresarial do Rio de Janeiro após pareceres favoráveis da Administração Judicial e do Ministério Público do Estado do Rio de Janeiro.

"Com a conclusão dessa etapa, a companhia segue comprometida com o crescimento de suas operações, o fortalecimento sustentável do seu modelo de negócio e o desenvolvimento da experiência de seus clientes", afirmou a Americanas, em fato relevante.

A ação da Americanas encerrou o dia em alta de quase 7%, cotada a R$ 5,97.

A varejista informou um rombo contábil bilionário em 11 de janeiro de 2023. Na ocasião, a companhia disse ter identificado "inconsistências em lançamentos contábeis" nos balanços, inicialmente estimadas em cerca de R$ 20 bilhões .

Após o caso se tornar público, Sergio Rial, que estava à frente da presidência da Americanas havia apenas nove dias, deixou o comando da empresa . Ele tinha assumido o posto no lugar de Miguel Gutierrez.

Os investidores — pessoas físicas e institucionais — iniciaram, então, uma corrida para se desfazer das ações. O movimento derrubou os papéis da companhia em quase 80% em um único dia , e a venda continuou nos pregões seguintes.

Em uma conferência após sua demissão, Rial disse que "a primeira grande conclusão é que não estamos falando de um número que está fora do balanço".

"A questão é que ele não está registrado de forma apropriada ao longo dos últimos anos", acrescentou.

No dia 19 de janeiro, a Americanas pediu a recuperação judicial na Justiça do Rio de Janeiro e teve suas ações retiradas da B3.

A primeira versão do plano de recuperação foi apresentada em março, mas o documento só foi aprovado em 19 de dezembro .

A dívida total considerada no plano de recuperação superava R$ 50 bilhões , dos quais cerca de R$ 42 bilhões correspondiam a débitos concursais, sujeitos à renegociação com credores.

O plano de recuperação previu, entre outros pontos, um aporte de R$ 12 bilhões dos acionistas de referência — o trio de bilionários Jorge Paulo Lemann, Carlos Alberto Sicupira e Marcel Herrmann Telles.

articles.title: Ron DeSantis says Tesla’s flying Roadster will be legal in Florida — and could ‘leapfrog golf carts in the Villages’
articles.summary: Tesla’s flying Roadster could pose a new challenge for insurers, with failed landings, costly repairs and liability questions adding to the regulatory hurdle...
articles.body:
Florida Governor Ron DeSantis wants to make Tesla's flying Roadster legal in the Sunshine State, even joking that it could "leapfrog golf carts in The Villages," one of the country's largest retirement communities.

"We will make sure that it's legal," DeSantis wrote on X .

Jeff Bezos backs a platform that lets anyone invest in rental homes for as little as $100 — 6 ways to build wealth like a landlord without actually being one

Dave Ramsey warns nearly 50% of Americans are making 1 big Social Security mistake. Here's what it is and 3 simple steps to fix it ASAP

A single line on your car insurance policy could be inflating your premium by up to 30% — here's what to change

His comments followed Elon Musk's Oct. 15 unveiling of the long-awaited Roadster at a SpaceX facility in Texas, years after Tesla first announced plans for the next-generation sports car.

The event, livestreamed on X, featured a Roadster fitted with high-pressure air tanks and thrusters designed to propel it into the air. During the demonstration, the vehicle accelerated up a curved ramp, became airborne, rotated 180 degrees and landed on its wheels.

"Flying cars are real," Musk declared during the event. He acknowledged the technology's "success is not guaranteed," but believes "it will probably work."

The caveat is that production isn't expected to begin until 2028 at the earliest, and Tesla has yet to announce a price for the flying "Rocket" version. Buyers can reserve a conventional Roadster with a $5,000 deposit, while the full-flight Rocket model will be available by invitation only.

DeSantis' endorsement raises a bigger question about the future of flying cars, particularly whether states like Florida can help bring the technology to market despite the regulatory hurdles that remain.

While DeSantis may be willing to welcome Tesla's flying Roadster to Florida, his endorsement alone won't make the vehicle street-legal — or clear it for flight.

The distinction is between state and federal authority. Florida regulates vehicle registration, licensing and the use of public roads, while the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) oversees federal vehicle safety standards and the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) regulates aircraft safety .

For Tesla, the regulatory requirements would depend on how the flying Roadster is classified and operated. A vehicle that can briefly jump into the air may face different requirements than one designed for sustained, controlled flight.

articles.title: Brick by brick: How LEGO is hooking adults on its sets
articles.summary: LEGO offers 225 adult-friendly building sets
articles.body:
Business is booming at LEGO thanks to an unexpected group of buyers.

The Danish toymaker saw global revenue soar by 21 percent from June to August after posting a 12-percent gain this year overall, and the company attributes some of that growth to adults buying LEGO sets for themselves.

The secret has been sets that touch on adult nostalgia and discovery, LEGO Global Chief Product & Marketing Officer Julia Goldin told The Wall Street Journal .

"Over the past eight years, we said there was a bigger opportunity with adults - not just people who are super-high-affinity fans, but people who maybe built a long time ago or had never built with bricks before - by giving them the things they would love to build now," she said.

LEGO now offers a wide range of adult-friendly builds , including paintings like Claude Monet's Bridge over a Pond of Water and Van Gogh's Sunflowers; Gen X's popular handheld Nintendo Gameboy, houseplants and a Polaroid camera.

Adults with LEGO habits include Hollywood stars such as Anna Kendrick and Daniel Radcliffe, as well as athletes such as NBA star Victor Wembanyama and Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams.

Of the more than 2,700 sets and products on the company's website, 225 were in its "LEGO Gifts and Collectibles for Adults" section Monday. That's 13 more than were listed in the section in early June.

Part of what has made the company popular with adults is that it markets to people's passions, not just age and gender, Goldin said. "You might think botanicals are women and F1 cars are men," she told The Journal .

"Yes, botanicals have a huge following among women and teenage girls, but bonsai trees are one of the top 10 products for men and teen boys. Speed Champions F1 cars show up in the top 10 for teen girls."

Adults' affection for LEGO brick-building is part of a wider trend in the retail industry - grown-ups are buying toys.

Adult-only households made up 55 percent of U.S. toy sales through the first half of the year, according to a report from retail research and analysis firm Circana. Toy sales among those aged 18 and older surged 25 percent in the first half of this year compared to the same period in 2025.

"We're seeing toys increasingly function as hobbies, fandom ecosystems, and social experiences rather than traditional children's products," Circana insights boss Kristen McLean said in the study.

This summer, LEGO announced a collaboration with pop star Olivia Rodrigo - five LEGO sets have the Grammy-winning artists branding, including a guitar, flower bouquet and record player. In a July interview with Nylon , Rodrigo explained why she thinks LEGO draws in adults.

"It's really great for people to do things with their hands," she said. "We're all on our phones so much and it's really nice to just have something that's relaxing and creative that is tactile."

articles.title: California settles 23andMe data breach claims for $6 million
articles.summary: Oct 19 (Reuters) - California Attorney General Rob Bonta on Monday announced the state will receive a $6 million settlement payment in 23andMe's ‌bankruptcy,...
articles.body:
Oct 19 (Reuters) - California Attorney General Rob Bonta on Monday announced the state will receive a $6 million settlement payment in 23andMe's ‌bankruptcy, resolving California's legal claims related to a 2023 data breach that ‌exposed 6.9 million customers' genetic and other personal information.

California had unsuccessfully tried to block the $305 million ​sale of 23andMe assets to TTAM Research Institute, a nonprofit controlled by 23andMe co-founder Anne Wojcicki. The state had argued that the bankruptcy sale violated California's Genetic Information Privacy Act, and it had said consumers did not give express consent to the ‌sale.

Once a trailblazer in DNA ⁠testing kits, 23andMe filed for bankruptcy in March 2025, seeking to sell its business at auction after a decline in demand ⁠and legal fallout from the data breach.

A US bankruptcy judge ruled against California's objections to the sale, and later ruled that the state could not sue to recover money from ​the bankrupt ​company's successor. California lost an appeal over ​the sale in federal district ‌court, and it agreed to drop further appeals as part of the $6 million settlement, according to court documents filed on Monday.

Customers of 23andMe retained the option to delete their data during the bankruptcy sale process, but California had argued that the court should have disallowed the transfer of any data unless 23andMe customers first ‌gave express consent to the sale.

"I am proud ​to fight for the privacy rights of Californians ​and to deliver this settlement ​for consumers who put their trust in 23andMe," Bonta, a ‌Democrat, said in a statement on Monday. "I ​want to remind ​Californians that customers of 23andMe can delete their private, genetic data — no matter who owns it."

The data breach exposed the genetic information of more than ​855,000 Californians, according to ‌the attorney general's office.

23andMe agreed to pay $46.75 million to victims of the ​2023 data breach as part of its bankruptcy.

(Reporting by Dietrich Knauth; ​Editing by Alexia Garamfalvi and Bill Berkrot)

articles.title: United Airlines CEO says US should have an inheritance tax 'close to 100%' and he'd pay it
articles.summary: United CEO Scotty Kirby says wealth inequality is 'a danger to our society.'
articles.body:
United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby gave a wide-ranging, often provocative interview to the New York Times, defending fees for aisle and window seats and countering the rise in airfares by asserting "it's expensive to fly airplanes."

"There are customers that pay more that get more," Kirby, 59, said in the interview that ran Oct. 18 .

But he struck a decidedly more populist note on the topic of wealth inequality — which he brought up when the Times asked him about waning trust in CEOs and his responsibility in dispelling it. Here's his full answer:

"Wealth inequality has become a danger to our society, and we need to address that," he said. "We should have a national wealth tax — it won't work by state because people will just move. And I think we should have inheritance taxes that get close to 100% at some level. I would pay them."

Kirby is not the first or only business titan to call for bigger taxes on the wealthiest Americans. Luminaries like Warren Buffett, Bill Gates, and George Soros have long advocated for increasing the tax burden at their rarefied wealth levels.

"We've updated our tax system before to keep up with changing times, and we need to do it again, starting with raising taxes on people like me," Gates wrote on his blog in 2020.

Marc Benioff, CEO of Salesforce ( CRM ), wrote in 2019 that "increasing taxes on high-income individuals like myself would help generate the trillions of dollars that we desperately need to improve education and healthcare and fight climate change."

Joe Biden was president, and Democrats in Congress were gearing up to pass legislation to tax unrealized gains on individuals with a net worth of at least $1 billion or annual income of $100 million for three consecutive years. Of course, that never happened, and after President Trump was reelected, Republicans in Congress passed the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, which included provisions that made lower marginal tax rates for high incomes permanent, along with other provisions benefiting wealthy Americans.

As for the inheritance taxes Kirby said he favors, there is no federal tax on individual beneficiaries of inherited assets. A few states impose a state inheritance tax.

There is a federal estate tax, but the exemption is so large — $15 million per person — that few people ever pay it. Only 0.2% of estates are large enough to be subject to the tax, and even then the tax applies only to the amount that exceeds the exemption threshold.

Molly Moorhead is economics editor for Yahoo Finance.

articles.title: Gold Holds Decline as Energy-Led Inflation Weighs on Rate Path
articles.summary: Gold held a decline, as elevated oil prices fueled inflation concerns and clouded the Federal Reserve’s path for interest-rate hikes.
articles.body:
(Bloomberg) -- Gold held a decline, as elevated oil prices fueled inflation concerns and clouded the Federal Reserve's path for interest-rate hikes.

Bullion was trading at around $4,135 an ounce, after falling 0.6% in the previous session. Oil hovered near a five-month high after Iran said it has "no choice" but to assert control over the Strait of Hormuz, while US lawmakers resisted President Donald Trump's diesel export deal with Russia.

Traders are trying to anticipate the Fed's next move in its battle to keep inflation in check. Chair Kevin Warsh used the eve of a communications blackout ahead of the central bank's meeting next week to signal support for keeping rates on hold. That spurred bets on the probability of a quarter-point hike to fall below 20%, from as likely as two-in-three late last month.

Bullion has generally held above $4,100 so far in October, consolidating after a decline of more than 6% in the previous month despite a stronger US dollar and high bond yields. Still, it's down about a fifth since the US-Iran conflict erupted in late February and traders still see a 90% probability of another rate increase by the end of the year. Higher borrowing costs are a headwind for gold, which doesn't pay interest.

Spot gold slipped 0.1% to $4,134.91 an ounce at 7:47 a.m. in Singapore, while silver fell 0.3% to $56.93 an ounce. Platinum and palladium also edged lower. The Bloomberg Dollar Spot Index, a gauge of the US currency, was little changed after gaining 0.1% in the previous session.

articles.title: Bolsa Família: pagamentos de outubro terminam amanhã | G1
articles.standfirst: Governo federal antecipou o calendário sob a justificativa de reduzir os impactos do super El Niño sobre famílias vulneráveis. Mudança também valerá para novembro e dezembro.
articles.summary: Governo federal antecipou o calendário sob a justificativa de reduzir os impactos do super El Niño sobre famílias vulneráveis. Mudança também valerá para novembro e dezembro.
articles.body:
Os pagamentos do Bolsa Família de outubro vão até quarta-feira (21), quando serão liberados os valores para beneficiários com Número de Identificação Social (NIS) terminado em 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 e 0.

Os beneficiários com NIS de final 1 e 2 receberam nesta segunda (19) e terça-feira (20), respectivamente.

Neste mês, o governo federal antecipou o calendário e concentrou os depósitos em três datas. A parcela é a primeira com o piso de R$ 691, anunciado em setembro.

Segundo o governo, a mudança anunciada na segunda-feira, seis dias antes do segundo turno das eleições, busca reduzir os impactos do super El Niño sobre as famílias mais vulneráveis.

A unificação também será adotada em novembro e dezembro, meses em que o fenômeno climático pode intensificar seus efeitos no país.

A decisão foi tomada pelo Ministério do Desenvolvimento e Assistência Social, Família e Combate à Fome (MDS), com base em análises sobre o aumento de desastres climáticos e nas previsões para os próximos meses.

Mesmo com a medida anunciada pelo governo nesta segunda-feira, os beneficiários com Número de Identificação Social (NIS) terminado em 1 e 2 receberam nas datas já previstas pelo calendário regular.

19/10: pagamentos para NIS com final 1 ;

20/10 : pagamentos para NIS com final 2 ;

21/10: pagamentos para NIS com finais 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 e 0 .

Os beneficiários que vivem em municípios com situação de emergência ou estado de calamidade pública reconhecidos pelo governo federal receberam o benefício de forma unificada nesta segunda-feira (19), independentemente do final do NIS.

A principal regra para receber o benefício é ter renda mensal familiar de até R$ 218 por pessoa.

Para se enquadrar do programa, é preciso somar a renda total e dividir pelo número de pessoas. Caso o valor fique abaixo dos R$ 218, a família está elegível ao Bolsa Família.

Os beneficiários também precisam arcar com contrapartidas, como:

manter crianças e adolescentes na escola;

fazer o acompanhamento pré-natal (no caso de gestantes);

manter as carteiras de vacinação atualizadas.

➡️ Para receber o Bolsa Família, as famílias precisam manter o Cadastro Único (CadÚnico) atualizado, atender aos critérios do programa e cumprir as condicionalidades de saúde e educação, como frequência escolar, vacinação das crianças e acompanhamento pré-natal das gestantes.

Os beneficiários podem consultar a situação do pagamento, os extratos e os valores liberados pelos aplicativos Bolsa Família e Caixa Tem ou pelo Portal Cidadão da Caixa.

Dúvidas sobre regras e cadastros podem ser esclarecidas pelo Disque Social do MDS, no telefone 121. Para informações sobre pagamentos e saques, a Caixa disponibiliza o telefone 111.

Os beneficiários recebem e podem movimentar os valores pelo aplicativo Caixa TEM e internet banking. Assim, não é necessário ir até uma agência da Caixa Econômica Federal — que é responsável pelo pagamento do Bolsa Família — para realizar o saque.

Segundo a Caixa, os beneficiários também podem utilizar o cartão do programa para realizar compras nos estabelecimentos comerciais, por meio da função de débito.

Além disso, há a opção de realizar saques nos terminais de autoatendimento, casas lotéricas e correspondentes Caixa Aqui, além das agências da Caixa.

articles.title: Como americanos enfrentam a alta da inflação: 'Já fiz coisas insanas para sobreviver' | G1
articles.standfirst: A inflação nos Estados Unidos continua subindo e o salto de outubro superou as expectativas. Como as pessoas estão fazendo para sobreviver?
articles.summary: A inflação nos Estados Unidos continua subindo e o salto de outubro superou as expectativas. Como as pessoas estão fazendo para sobreviver?
articles.body:
Kathryn Vaughn tem três empregos para poder sustentar a casa — Foto: Kathryn Vaughn via BBC

Neste segundo semestre, Kathryn Vaughn voltou ao trabalho em uma escola do ensino fundamental na zona rural do Estado americano do Tennessee com muito mais estresse sobre o próprio orçamento do que nos anos anteriores.

Vaughn tem 46 anos e, como muitos outros americanos, está fazendo malabarismos para prover sua família com o aumento dos custos de " tudo ", segundo suas próprias palavras.

Ela trabalha em três empregos diferentes, incluindo como professora de artes em uma escola primária, para manter sua família de quatro pessoas frente à inflação que continua a subir nos Estados Unidos.

O índice de inflação de setembro no país superou as previsões. Nos últimos 12 meses, os preços subiram em 3,7%, contra 3,4% nos 12 meses até agosto, segundo os números oficiais publicados na quarta-feira (14/10).

Os altos preços da energia elevaram o custo de vida nos Estados Unidos. Os preços do óleo diesel atingiram recordes de alta e o custo da gasolina também subiu. Todos estes aumentos atingiram o bolso do cidadão comum americano.

Depois das aulas, Vaughn segue para seu segundo emprego como facilitadora em um programa para jovens em risco. O filho de cinco anos pode acompanhá-la, o que reduz a necessidade e o custo da creche para a família Vaughn.

"Já fiz coisas incrivelmente insanas para sobreviver", ela conta.

"Fui modelo de mãos para uma joalheria local, vendo tudo o que fica por mais de 10 minutos na minha casa em sites de troca no Facebook e revendo roupas no ThredUp e no Poshmark [plataformas online]."

Vaughn também escreve obituários para pessoas que morreram, para ganhar um dinheiro extra. E tudo isso ainda não é suficiente para sustentar sua família.

Punal Bhavsar achava que 2026 seria o ano em que ele juntaria dinheiro suficiente para comprar uma casa.

"Pensei que as taxas de juros fossem cair e que conseguiria, então, comprar uma casa, mas não acho que isso seja provável de acontecer agora", conta.

Ele tem 39 anos e afirma que o aumento do custo dos produtos fez com que ficasse difícil economizar dinheiro. E o que mais pesou para Bhavsar é o preço da gasolina .

"Dirijo um carro que usa gasolina premium", segundo ele, "e, infelizmente, na Califórnia e na região onde moro, ela custa quase US$ 6 [ por galão ]", cerca de R$ 8 por litro.

Em novembro, haverá eleições de meio de mandato nos Estados Unidos e a tumultuada economia do país certamente estará na mente dos eleitores. Bhavsar afirma que esta única questão pode decidir seu voto.

"Para mim, os preços da gasolina simplesmente precisam ficar sob controle."

Bhavsar descreveu o panorama econômico atual como sombrio. E os números apoiam sua impressão.

O Índice Gallup de Confiança na Economia resume as avaliações dos cidadãos americanos sobre o panorama e as condições econômicas do momento e as classifica em uma escala de -100 a +100. Em setembro, o índice chegou a -40 .

Em uma pesquisa do jornal britânico The Guardian realizada em meados do ano, o percentual de entrevistados que acreditam que os Estados Unidos enfrentam uma crise de custo de vida atingiu impressionantes 95%.

Neste final de ano, as pessoas estão encontrando formas de lidar com a situação em todo o país.

Caitlin Green se mudou pela primeira vez para o Estado americano de Utah sete anos atrás. Na época, sua mãe fez a mudança para sua nova casa e lhe deu um bom conselho: "Se, algum dia, você precisar de uma refeição fácil e barata, procure sempre carne moída."

Mas, com o aumento dos preços, Green tem tido dificuldade para seguir esta orientação. Ela se lembra de já ter pago US$ 4,40 (cerca de R$ 22 ) por 1 kg de carne moída. Agora, ela conta que está pagando US$ 17,60 (cerca de R$ 88 ).

Por isso, Green e seu marido, às vezes, escolhem alternativas, como frango ou peru moído.

A carne moída "é quase... não um luxo, como o bife... mas está a ponto de se tornar um luxo", segundo ela. "Precisamos pensar se formos comprar."

Green e seu marido gastavam cerca de US$ 200 (R$ 1 mil) por mês no mercado. Agora, eles gastam mensalmente US$ 400 (cerca de R$ 2 mil).

"Entendo que a inflação existe, mas acho que nunca na vida vi a inflação subir tão rápido e de forma tão drástica", ela conta.

Para a professora Vaughn, do Tennessee, as decisões difíceis não param de chegar.

Ela levou um susto quando os filhos voltaram às aulas e viu a conta de US$ 130 (cerca de R$ 650) de material escolar para o filho de cinco anos de idade.

Com os preços dos alimentos em alta, Vaughn decidiu que o menino passaria a comprar o almoço na escola todos os dias, em vez de levar comida de casa. Ela fez as contas e concluiu que essa opção sairia mais barata.

A família também desistiu de uma viagem para a Flórida neste segundo semestre para ver os pais de Vaughn porque o preço da gasolina está alto demais.

"O custo de tudo está absurdo. Gasolina para ir trabalhar, meu seguro aumentou, alimentar dois filhos e um marido. É demais."

articles.title: Aposentada que nega ter contratado cartão consignado deve receber indenização de banco em MG | G1
articles.standfirst: Justiça reconheceu descontos indevidos no benefício previdenciário e aumentou a indenização a ser paga pelo Agibank em Guapé.
articles.summary: Justiça reconheceu descontos indevidos no benefício previdenciário e aumentou a indenização a ser paga pelo Agibank em Guapé.
articles.body:
Uma aposentada vítima de fraude bancária deve ser indenizada pelo Banco Agibank após sofrer descontos indevidos na aposentadoria em Guapé , no Sul de Minas . O Tribunal de Justiça de Minas Gerais (TJMG) aumentou o valor da indenização por danos morais de R$ 3 mil para 15 salários mínimos.

Segundo o processo, a idosa identificou descontos relacionados a um contrato de cartão de crédito consignado com reserva de margem consignável. Ela afirmou que nunca solicitou o serviço, não assinou o contrato nem recebeu qualquer quantia.

Aposentada que nega ter contratado cartão consignado deve receber indenização de banco em MG — Foto: Envato Elements / Imagem Ilustrativa

O banco alegou que a contratação foi regular e que a consumidora teria autorizado a operação por meio de assinatura eletrônica e biometria facial. A instituição também pediu que, caso o contrato fosse anulado, a aposentada devolvesse os valores supostamente depositados.

Na primeira decisão, a Justiça reconheceu a ilegalidade dos descontos, declarou que a dívida não existia e determinou a devolução dos valores retidos, inclusive em dobro para os descontos realizados após 30 de março de 2021. Na ocasião, os danos morais foram fixados em R$ 3 mil.

A aposentada recorreu para pedir o aumento da indenização. Ao analisar o caso, os magistrados do 6º Núcleo de Justiça 4.0 – Cível Privado do TJMG entenderam que o valor inicial era insuficiente para compensar os prejuízos e desestimular práticas semelhantes.

O relator do recurso, juiz convocado Clayton Rosa de Resende, destacou que os descontos atingiram uma verba essencial para o sustento da idosa, que tem mais de 70 anos e depende exclusivamente de um benefício previdenciário de valor modesto.

A decisão também ressaltou que as instituições financeiras podem ser responsabilizadas por fraudes cometidas por terceiros em operações bancárias e que cabe aos bancos comprovar a autenticidade dos contratos contestados.

Com isso, o TJMG reformou parcialmente a sentença para aumentar a indenização por danos morais para 15 salários mínimos.

Procurado pelo g1 , o Agibank informou que o processo está em fase de recurso e que não há condenação definitiva.

Segundo o banco, a cobrança questionada decorre da contratação de um produto realizada conforme as condições aplicáveis, e a documentação foi apresentada à Justiça.

A instituição também afirmou que segue a legislação vigente e que suas operações são pautadas pela transparência e pela fundamentação contratual.

articles.title: Indian Railways cracks down on food quality issues after passenger complaints; IRCTC partners with QCI for surprise audits on trains and stations with digital evidence to speed up action
articles.summary: The food quality on trains may see an improvement with the Quality Council of India (QCI) looking to appoint certified professionals to carry out
articles.body: The food quality on trains may see an improvement with the Quality Council of India (QCI) looking to appoint certified professionals to carry out independent, technology-enabled checks of food safety and hygiene at railway stations and aboard trains across the Indian Railways network.Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation Limited (IRCTC) has entered into a strategic Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with QCI to strengthen compliance with food safety and hygiene standards across the railway system, according to a statement issued by the Railway Ministry"Under this strategic alliance, QCI will deploy certified professionals to conduct intense, unannounced quarterly and half-yearly inspection cycles," the ministry said.It added: "These audits will enforce strict compliance with statutory Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) regulations and international culinary standards."Addressing passenger complaints on foodOfficials said the decision to introduce independent inspections followed repeated passenger complaints about poor food quality and unhygienic catering practices. The ministry subsequently decided to bring in a third-party agency to audit food safety and hygiene."To eliminate data tampering and guarantee absolute transparency, the audit process will leverage QCI's pioneer digital infrastructure," the ministry said.As part of the system, inspectors will use a mobile application to record their findings, with geo-tagging, time-stamps and photographic evidence made mandatory.Audit reports will have to be submitted within 24 hours, allowing operational shortcomings to be identified promptly and enabling corrective and preventive measures to be tracked against vendors found violating the prescribed standards.Explaining how the initiative would benefit passengers, the ministry said: "Rigorous independent screening across trains ensures passengers are protected from subpar onboard meal preparation."It also highlighted the need for uniform hygiene standards at station-based catering facilities, stating: "Complete standardisation guarantees immaculate cooking environments across all major station-based static units," the ministry added.The ministry said the use of digitally documented evidence and the requirement to submit reports within 24 hours would help speed up corrective action and the imposition of penalties against catering licensees where necessary.IRCTC Food checksIndian Railways serves an average of around 58 crore meals annually. Over the past three years, IRCTC has taken punitive action in response to complaints against several vendors.According to a recent PIB release, these measures include imposing fines of Rs 5.13 crore, issuing 54 show-cause notices, terminating six contracts and debarring licensees for violations related to food quality and hygiene. IRCTC has made the list of debarred licensees available on its website.Railway and IRCTC officials, including Food Safety Officers, carry out routine as well as surprise inspections to check food quality, hygiene, safety and compliance with applicable regulations.These inspections examine several aspects of catering operations, including food safety, staff deployment, upkeep of equipment, cleanliness and adherence to prescribed standards. They also seek to encourage best practices in food handling, storage and preparation.According to Railway minister Ashwini Vaishnaw’s recent reply to a question in Rajya Sabha, IRCTC is taking the following measures on food quality:Providing meals that are prepared at designated base kitchens.Setting up modern base kitchens at some select locations.Installing CCTV cameras in base kitchens that enables real-time surveillance and improves the monitoring of food preparation.Identifying and using popular branded raw materials for preparing food.Appointing Food Safety Supervisors at base kitchens to oversee food safety and hygienic practices.Deploying IRCTC supervisors on board trains.Carrying out deep cleaning at regular intervals and conducting periodic pest-control activities in base kitchens and pantry cars.You use AI every day. articles.body: MUMBAI: Benchmark indices snapped a two-day winning streak on Monday, with sensex falling 876 points, or 1.2%, to 73,853 and Nifty declining 257 points, or 1.1%, to 22,889 as selling in private sector banks and IT stocks weighed on sentiment. Sensex opened 211 points lower at 74,518, while Nifty started 63 points down at 23,083. Selling intensified through the session.Axis Bank was the biggest laggard among Nifty constituents, falling 4.2%. HDFC Bank declined 2.3% and Tata Motors lost more than 3%. On the other hand, JSW Steel gained 2%, ONGC rose 1.4% and State Bank of India advanced 1.2%.According to Vinay Rajani, senior technical research analyst at HDFC Securities, Nifty is approaching support at 22,800, where it could resume its uptrend. “However, a decisive break below the positional support at 22,500 would weaken the bullish outlook and warrant caution,” he said. Most sectoral indices ended lower, with private banks, IT and FMCG among the worst hit. The Nifty PSU Bank index was the only sectoral index to finish in positive territory, gaining 2.5%, while the Nifty Private Bank index fell 1.9%. Union Bank gained 5.3%, highlighting the divergence between public and private sector lenders.Disappointing quarterly earnings from major private lenders, elevated crude oil prices and continued foreign investor outflows added to the pressure. Results from HDFC Bank and Axis Bank missed consensus expectations amid concerns over shrinking net interest margins. articles.title: Crude holds near $110 per barrel as Middle East tensions keep supply concerns alive
articles.summary: Oil prices hovered near $110 a barrel on Tuesday as traders assessed the impact of Washington’s decision to ease some restrictions on Russian energy
articles.body: Oil prices hovered near $110 a barrel on Tuesday as traders assessed the impact of Washington’s decision to ease some restrictions on Russian energy exports, while fresh attacks claimed by Yemen’s Houthis against Saudi targets added to concerns over potential supply disruptions in the Middle East.WTI crude was trading at $98.72, up 18 cents, or 0.18%, while Brent crude stood at $109.70, gaining 16 cents, or 0.15%. Brent had climbed to $110.70 a barrel in the previous session, its highest level since May 20.The market was weighing the possibility of additional Russian oil and fuel supplies following an executive order issued by US President Donald Trump on Friday night. The order waived key Russia-related US sanctions and tariffs, including duties on Russian goods and penalties for purchasing the country’s oil and gas. However, Trump said on Saturday that he had yet to announce a final decision, while Secretary of State Marco Rubio said officials needed more time to assess the situation.Russia’s crude oil production rose by 65,000 barrels per day in September to 8.43 million barrels per day, according to the International Energy Agency last week. Despite the increase, output remained around 870,000 barrels per day below the level recorded a year earlier.The prospect of more Russian supplies has offered a possible counterweight to concerns about disruptions elsewhere, but risks to energy infrastructure in the Gulf region remain a key concern for traders.Houthi attacks add to supply concernsFresh security concerns emerged after Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis said on Monday they had carried out several attacks targeting Saudi energy, airport and military facilities. The sites named included an Aramco facility in Yanbu, the Shaybah oilfield, King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh and Abha airport.Saudi authorities did not immediately confirm the claims, and Reuters could not independently verify them.Separately, an attack by the Houthis on a government security forces training camp in Yemen’s Shabwa province on Monday killed 58 people and injured more than 200.The latest attacks have added to concerns about regional stability and the safety of energy supplies, helping keep oil prices above the $100-a-barrel mark despite the prospect of increased Russian supply.You use AI every day. articles.title: Tata Trusts row: Sir Dorabji Tata Trust files response to commissioner
articles.summary: MUMBAI: Sir Dorabji Tata Trust (SDTT) on Monday filed its response with Maharashtra Charity Commissioner (MCC) to complaints lodged by trustees Venu
articles.body: MUMBAI: Sir Dorabji Tata Trust (SDTT) on Monday filed its response with Maharashtra Charity Commissioner (MCC) to complaints lodged by trustees Venu Srinivasan and Vijay Singh, meeting the extended Oct 19 deadline for its submission.The complaints sought an inquiry into SDTT’s administration and governance, including the appointments of Noel Tata as a perpetual trustee and his son, Neville Tata, as a trustee. They further alleged that Srinivasan was excluded from the decision-making process surrounding Neville’s appointment and questioned the involvement of SDTT and Noel in the commercial and strategic affairs of Tata Sons.A Tata Trusts spokesperson confirmed the response had been filed but declined to share the contents of the submission, which runs into dozens of pages.MCC had initially directed SDTT to file its response by Oct 12, but granted the trust additional time, extending the deadline to Oct 19.The complainants had also sought interim directions, including the suspension or removal of trustees from SDTT, restrictions on Noel’s participation in matters concerning Tata Sons, and a bar on his exercising voting rights on behalf of SDTT at Tata Sons shareholder meetings. SDTT is the largest shareholder in Tata Sons, with a 28% stake, followed by Sir Ratan Tata Trust (SRTT) with 24%. MCC had barred SRTT from holding trustee meetings until an investigation into separate complaints filed by Srinivasan is completed. The latest complaints, filed on Sept 25 by Srinivasan and Singh, followed disagreements over the future of Tata Sons, including whether the company should remain unlisted and how liquidity should be provided to minority shareholder Shapoorji Pallonji (SP) Group.Srinivasan had alleged that Noel had taken a direct role in identifying, negotiating and facilitating liquidity for the SP Group through the monetisation of Tata Sons shareholding.You use AI every day. articles.title: Harish Bhat resigns from Trent board after 12 years
articles.summary: MUMBAI: Harish Bhat, a long-serving Tata executive, has resigned from Trent, the retailer chaired by Noel Tata, citing growing personal and professional
articles.body: MUMBAI: Harish Bhat, a long-serving Tata executive, has resigned from Trent, the retailer chaired by Noel Tata, citing growing personal and professional commitments.Bhat, 63, served on Trent’s board for 12 years. An alumnus of BITS Pilani and IIM Ahmedabad, he continues to serve on the boards of Tata Starbucks and Infiniti Retail (Croma).In his resignation letter to Noel, Bhat described his tenure on Trent’s board as a “pleasure and privilege”, crediting Tata’s leadership for the company’s rapid growth and transformation.Bhat is the only member of former Tata Sons chairman Cyrus Mistry’s inner circle to remain within the Tata group after Mistry’s acrimonious split with the conglomerate in 2016.His resignation has revived debate about shifting loyalties within India’s largest conglomerate. Nirmalya Kumar, who also served on Mistry’s core team, wrote in a LinkedIn post that Bhat was “the first, and only member” of the group executive council “to switch sides to the new regime when Mistry was fired and go to the press with it”. Kumar argued that the move helped secure Bhat’s position during current chairman N Chandrasekaran’s era, albeit at a cost. “The reward was continued employment during N Chandrasekaran era with a honorific title but no power”.As the balance of power gradually shifts towards Noel, some Tata group observers see Bhat’s departure as another sign of changing dynamics within the conglomerate. Kumar, who returned to academia after his stint with the Tata group, said the transition was prompting a fresh realignment of loyalties. “Now tables are turning from Chandra to Noel Tata and it’s time to sing praises to Noel Tata! Just like the Tata board, many of these political professionals are looking to unemployment!” he said.During Bhat’s career with the Tata group, he held several senior leadership roles, including brand custodian at Tata Sons, managing director of Tata Global Beverages, and chief operating officer of Titan’s watches and accessories business.You use AI every day. articles.title: ‘SC order won’t impact growth’: Yes Bank
articles.summary: MUMBAI: Yes Bank has told investors that Supreme Court’s order to restore Rs 8,415 crore of additional tier-1 (AT1) bonds written off during its March
articles.body: MUMBAI: Yes Bank has told investors that Supreme Court’s order to restore Rs 8,415 crore of additional tier-1 (AT1) bonds written off during its March 2020 restructuring would not constrain growth, citing deferred tax assets (DTAs) and other capital buffers to absorb the impact. Rating agencies said the ruling would not materially affect the bank’s credit profile, although it has implications for its capital structure.Crisil Ratings said Yes Bank could absorb the AT1 bond ruling’s impact through internal accruals and fresh capital, with support expected from its largest shareholder, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation. While the ruling is not expected to materially affect its credit profile, coupon payments for the intervening 5.5 years remain uncertain. In another case, Dhanlaxmi Bank was earlier allowed to defer coupons on Basel II-compliant tier-II bonds.Analysts said reversing the AT1 write-down, originally credited to the profit and loss account, could leave the bank without the profits needed to pay coupons under the conditions of the AT1 bonds. As a result, the bank’s maximum liability was likely to be Rs 8,415 crore.In an earnings call, managing director and CEO Vinay Tonse said the bank was examining the judgment and its options. “We respect the judgment and are examining it carefully, including the options available to the bank,” he said.CFO Niranjan Banodkar said reinstating the AT1 principal would reduce the common equity tier-I (CET-1) ratio by around 240 basis points on a pro forma basis, based on an indicative assessment as of Sept 30, 2026, including profits. The overall tier-I capital ratio would remain around 13.7%, while the pro forma CET-1 ratio would be 11.4%. Banodkar said the bank was reviewing the judgment, legal options and capital plans.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.title: In-kind welfare: 22 crore move up consumption ladder
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: In-kind social transfers ranging from free foodgrains under the public distribution system (PDS) to laptops, bicycles and school uniforms have
articles.body: NEW DELHI: In-kind social transfers ranging from free foodgrains under the public distribution system (PDS) to laptops, bicycles and school uniforms have pushed nearly 22 crore people -- comprising around 19% of rural population and 8.4% of those in urban areas -- into higher consumption brackets, a new study in an NSO journal showed.Using the household consumption expenditure survey (HCES) 2022–23 unit-level data, the NSO study concluded that 15.8% of the population at the national level saw improvement in their level of living as they moved into higher monthly per capita consumption expenditure (MPCE) category once the monetary value of free goods was imputed.Incorporating these welfare measures also reduced consumption inequality, measured by Gini coefficient, pointing to a boost in effective purchasing power as it freed up some cash that would have been allocated for buying some of these goods.The findings also highlighted a distinct regional divergence in welfare impact. West Bengal led with over 40% of its total population (46.5% rural and 24.9% urban) transitioning to higher consumption brackets due to in-kind transfers. This was followed by Chhattisgarh (29.2%), Assam (29%), Karnataka (28.4%), and Uttar Pradesh (22.7%). In contrast, industrialised and higher-baseline states reported significantly lower transition rates, with Gujarat seeing only 3.7% population transitioning to a higher consumption bracket, followed by Kerala (4.6%) and Haryana (7.1%).Despite concerns over several of such transfers being populist in nature, often announced ahead of elections, the study concluded that in-kind social welfare acted as a progressive measure as maximum upward mobility was concentrated at the bottom of the pyramid, indicating that welfare benefits effectively reach the targeted, lower-income households.Researchers, however, noted that the 22-crore figure was a conservative estimate as major public services, specifically free healthcare benefits under schemes such as Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY) and free school education were excluded from the calculations due to survey design limitations. Factoring in the out-of-pocket savings from health and education would indicate an even broader elevation of living standards across Indian households, it said.You use AI every day. articles.title: Husband and wife sell property; Income Tax dept alleges Rs 3.30 crore sale against Rs 1.60 crore in deed, cites WhatsApp chats, Excel sheets to claim Rs 1.70 crore cash receipts, but ITAT gives relief
articles.summary: Property related transactions can sometimes be complicated. Recording the same in your income tax return is equally important.
articles.body: Property related transactions can sometimes be complicated. Recording the same in your income tax return is equally important. But what if the Income Tax Department sends you a notice for unexplained cash receipts, believing that you have received a part of the payment for property sale in cash.In one such case, the tax department relied on WhatsApp messages and Excel spreadsheets to reach the conclusion that the property had been sold for an amount higher than the one disclosed. The assessee finally won the case in Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT), Delhi.What the case is aboutThe dispute concerned a man and his wife, who jointly owned a property in Delhi before selling it.The Income Tax Department alleged that the buyers had paid an additional amount in cash beyond the sale consideration documented in the registered conveyance deed.Also Read | Man sold his house and bought a Rs 1.10 crore flat jointly with wife; income tax department denies Rs 55.48 lakh capital gains exemption for half the amount, but ITAT Mumbai gives full reliefThe assessing officer calculated the total transaction value at around Rs 3.30 crore, whereas the registered sale deed recorded a consideration of Rs 1.60 crore. The department regarded the difference of Rs 1.70 crore as cash received by the sellers but not disclosed in the documents.The case arose from a search conducted in 2021, involving a group of companies. According to the tax department, an Excel workbook titled “BOSS -DEC 18 onwards”, handwritten diary entries and other seized material pointed to cash payments allegedly made to the man in connection with a property in Delhi, jointly owned by him and his wife.The department alleged that Rs 1.70 crore had been paid in cash by the group owner in connection with the property transaction to the husband and wife. Its case included entries for Rs 1.55 crore and a further Rs 15 lakh. It also relied on handwritten records and WhatsApp conversations involving several people.The Assessing Officer (AO) also drew on WhatsApp conversations that mentioned payments of Rs 50 lakh, Rs 50 lakh, Rs 20 lakh, Rs 5 lakh and Rs 30 lakh. These amounts added up to Rs 1.55 crore.The AO treated the alleged amount as undisclosed cash receipts and made an addition under Section 69A read with Section 115BBE of the Income Tax Act. The Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) subsequently sustained an addition of Rs 1,16,25,000 out of the Rs 1.70 crore assessed, giving part relief.However the man appealed in ITAT.Also Read | He inherited land from mother, redeveloped home & received Rs 75 lakh from builder; taxman denied capital gains exemption, but ITAT Delhi gives relief, ruling multiple floors can qualify as one houseWhy did the taxpayer win relief?The man’s representative disputed the reliance on the seized material and argued that he had not been given a proper opportunity to cross-examine the people whose statements and communications were used against him.He also challenged the legality of the proceedings under Section 153C, including the recording of a consolidated satisfaction note covering seven assessment years.The taxpayer further argued that the alleged cash consideration related to a property sold through a registered conveyance deed dated October 31, 2019, falling in assessment year 2020-21, rather than the assessment year under appeal, 2019-20.The tribunal found that the WhatsApp conversations relied upon by the tax authorities largely contained monetary figures but did not clearly establish what the payments were for or the purpose behind them.“The WhatsApp chats and seized documents merely referred to certain figures and alleged transactions but did not conclusively establish that the assessee had received unaccounted cash,” CA Avinash Kumar Rao, Partner at Mohindra & Associates told ET.CA Suresh Surana said the assessing officer had also not adequately examined the people connected with the alleged payments. The taxpayer was not given a proper opportunity to cross-examine them.Also Read | Man had Rs 2 crore bank deposit and didn’t file ITR, faced Rs 2.51 crore tax addition; ITAT Chennai quashes reassessment after Income Tax Department missed 6-year deadline by 5 daysThe tribunal also noted that the Income Tax Department had not summoned a man despite relying substantially on his statement and documents recovered from him to support its allegations.The tribunal observed that if the department intended to rely on the chats and related material as evidence of cash consideration, “it was essential for the assessing officer to have examined these persons on oath and also give the assessee an opportunity to cross-examine these persons.”It explained that WhatsApp messages and supporting documents needed to be properly tested rather than treated as conclusive proof. As the order put it, “the inferences drawn cannot be considered to be conclusively based on relevant and admissible evidence, but become more of suspicious circumstance” if the necessary examination and opportunity to challenge the evidence are missing.The Income Tax Department had also relied on a common satisfaction note covering seven assessment years. However, it had not identified relevant incriminating material for every assessment year included in the note.Surana explains that the ITAT held that the department was required to demonstrate a clear link between the material seized during the search and the income relating to each individual assessment year before initiating proceedings under Section 153C.On these grounds, the tribunal allowed both the quantum appeal and the consequential penalty appeal. Its final direction was explicit: “The impugned assessment and penalty stands quashed.”The order was pronounced on September 9, 2026.It’s important to note that the decision turned on the evidentiary shortcomings and legal defects identified by the tribunal; it should not be read as a finding that the alleged cash payments definitely did not occur.Also Read | Woman declared Rs 67.4 lakh ancestral jewellery in her ITR which led to additions by tax department; ITAT Mumbai deleted it on basis of old records, but rejected her Rs 12 lakh HUF brokerage claimSignificance of rulingThe decision reiterates a fundamental principle of tax law: even strong suspicion cannot take the place of conclusive evidence. The Income Tax Department can examine WhatsApp conversations, Excel spreadsheets and handwritten records, but simply finding such material does not automatically prove that a taxpayer earned undisclosed income.CA Avinash Kumar Rao advises taxpayers facing allegations based on third-party statements or conversations to obtain copies of the material cited against them and assess its context and relevance. They should also ask for an opportunity to cross-examine the individuals concerned. Such requests are preferably made in writing while the assessment proceedings are underway.The ruling also underlines that procedural safeguards prescribed under the Income-tax Act must be followed rather than treated as formal requirements that can be overlooked.You use AI every day. articles.title: Urea import prices hit 15-month low, but fertiliser subsidy burden may rise marginally due to higher DAP & Sulphur rates
articles.summary: New Delhi: The import price of urea fell to $392 per tonne in Sept, its lowest level since June 2025 and nearly 59% below the peak of $947 per tonne
articles.body: New Delhi: The import price of urea fell to $392 per tonne in Sept, its lowest level since June 2025 and nearly 59% below the peak of $947 per tonne recorded in May this year. This is expected to ease pressure on govt’s fertiliser subsidy bill, which was expected to rise sharply amid the West Asia crisis.However, elevated prices of diammonium phosphate (DAP), muriate of potash (MOP) and sulphur are likely to push the subsidy outgo in 2026-27 by Rs 20,000-25,000 crore above the Rs 2.17 lakh crore budget allocation. This is still much less than the govt’s internal estimates during the major supply disruptions in April-May, which had pegged the fertiliser subsidy bill at around Rs 3 lakh crore.Govt data show that the import price of diammonium phosphate (DAP) declined by barely 3% to $906 per tonne in Sept from its peak of $933 in June, while sulphur prices have surged to a record level above $1,000 per tonne, registering over 200% increase compared to last year. However, this will not impact farmers, who will continue to get these fertilisers at subsided rates.Urea import prices have fallen sharply due to easing international prices and improved supply with India diversifying sources. One of the main reasons is China renewing urea exports, which has increased competition among sellers. articles.standfirst: Una creadora de contenido muestra dos nóminas en sus redes sociale
articles.summary: Una creadora de contenido muestra dos nóminas en sus redes sociale
articles.body: El sueldo de un ingeniero especializado en mecánica de rocas, en Sudáfrica, ha roto TikTok. La creadora de contenido Boni Xaba ha compartido en varios vídeos dos nóminas de un trabajador en prácticas que ha provocado que muchos de sus seguidores, en los comentarios, se replanteen sus estudios. "¡En prácticas!", ha recalcado Boni. En la primera nómina, que incluye una cuantiosa bonificación de rendimiento, el sueldo de este estudiante de segundo año trabajando para una empresa minera de carbón es de 127.195 rands netos. Es decir, unos 7.000 euros al cambio. En la segunda, 2.500 netos. Todos los apartados aparecen desglosados. Algunos de sus seguidores han reaccionado con una enorme sorpresa a las cifras "¿Si un becario cobra eso, cuánto cobra un sénior? ¿Dónde estaba la carrera de Ingeniería de Rocas cuando elegía mis estudios?" son algunas de las preguntas que pueden leerse en los comentarios. Medios sudafricanos han informado que para obtener la certificación de Ingeniero de Rocas es necesario una Ingeniería de Minas y, posteriormente, una certificación adicional del Consejo de Minerales de Sudáfrica. El sueldo, en cualquier caso, parece claramente atractivo. De todas formas, algunos usuarios han cuestionado si el trabajo compensa por sus riesgos al tratarse de una mina de carbón. "Plus por peligrosidad. Cuando se quedan atrapados bajo tierra, entenderás por qué ganan tanto. Un ingeniero de rocas en minería subterránea gana más que uno en minería a cielo abierto", argumentan en los comentarios de la publicación. En España, según portales especializados en empleo, el sueldo de un ingeniero especializado en mecánica de rocas o un ingeniero geotécnico va desde los 35.000 hasta los 60.000 euros brutos anuales, en función de la experiencia y el cargo. Las obras subterráneas, en principio, ofrecen salarios más elevados. Estas cifras, en cualquier caso, son orientativas y pueden depender de numerosos factores.

articles.title: No buyers, higher costs: US homebuilder confidence hits 14-year low
articles.summary: US homebuilder confidence fell to its lowest level in more than 14 years in October, with rising mortgage rates, expensive construction materials and
articles.body: US homebuilder confidence fell to its lowest level in more than 14 years in October, with rising mortgage rates, expensive construction materials and labour shortages weighing on the housing market, according to a survey released on Monday.The National Association of Home Builders (NAHB)/Wells Fargo Housing Market Index slipped three points to 29, its weakest reading since June 2012. The decline was steeper than economists polled by Reuters had anticipated, with their forecast standing at 31.The Middle East conflict has pushed up energy prices and borrowing costs, adding to the financial pressure on builders. Mortgage rates have climbed alongside Treasury yields as the US-Israeli war with Iran fuels inflation. Freddie Mac data showed that the average rate on a 30-year fixed mortgage reached 7.40% last week, its highest level in nearly three years.Higher borrowing costs are weighing on home sales, while tariffs on imports have added to construction expenses. Builders are also facing labour shortages amid an immigration crackdown."Builders are also contending with higher costs for construction loans, building materials and diesel, as well as persistent labor shortages," said NAHB chairman Bill Owens. "Nationwide, more than one-third of builders reported immigration enforcement activity in their market areas during the past month, causing construction delays and discouraging legal workers from reporting to work."Price cuts and incentives rise as buyers hold backWeak demand has left builders with a growing stock of unsold new homes, making them more reluctant to start construction on additional single-family housing projects.To attract buyers, 43% of builders reported reducing prices in October, the highest proportion recorded during the 2020-2026 period. The average price cut remained at 6% for the seventh consecutive month. Meanwhile, 65% of builders offered sales incentives, marking the 19th month in a row that at least 60% have resorted to such measures.The survey also showed deterioration across all three measures of housing market activity. The index measuring current sales conditions fell two points to 33, while expectations for sales over the coming months dropped five points to 32. Prospective buyer traffic also declined five points to 18."Higher mortgage rates, elevated construction costs and weaker consumer confidence are keeping more buyers on the sidelines," said Robert Dietz, NAHB chief economist. "As a result, buyer traffic has fallen to its lowest level since April 2012, excluding the pandemic's onset in April 2020."Housing affordability remains a concern ahead of US midtermsThe combination of high mortgage rates and persistently expensive homes has placed housing affordability at the centre of economic concerns ahead of the November 3 midterm elections, which will determine control of Congress.President Donald Trump earlier this year declined to sign a bipartisan bill aimed at improving housing affordability, dismissing it as "a big yawn". He instead pressed Congress, including fellow Republicans who resisted his demands, to first pass separate and contentious voting requirements.The latest survey highlights the continuing challenges facing homebuilders as higher costs and subdued buyer demand affect their decisions on pricing, incentives and new construction.You use AI every day. Esta disminución refleja un cambio significativo en la tarifa diaria. A medida que avanza el día, es esencial analizar las horas más caras y más baratas para optimizar el consumo. De 19:00 a 21:00, los precios alcanzan cifras alarmantemente altas, con valores de 271.4 €/MWh y 259.03 €/MWh respectivamente, marcando un punto crítico en el consumo energético. Esta tendencia resalta la importancia de gestionar el consumo durante estas franjas horarias para evitar costos excesivos. La electricidad es más económica durante las primeras horas de la mañana y al mediodía. Las mejores oportunidades de ahorro se concentran entre las 14:00 - 15:00 horas, donde se alcanza un precio de 88.6 €/MWh y de 15:00 - 16:00 con un mínimo de 61.66 €/MWh. articles.body: Nepal has barred the import, sale and distribution of Priyagold biscuits made by India based Surya Food and Agro Ltd, after food safety concerns flagged by Indian authorities.Nepal’s Food Technology and Quality Control Department (FTQCD) announced the restrictions in a notice issued on Monday, classifying the biscuits as sub-standard. The move follows action by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), which has suspended the manufacturer's licence and initiated legal proceedings for prosecution.According to FSSAI, an inspection of Surya Food and Agro revealed serious deficiencies in food safety and hygiene. The regulator also initiated prosecution proceedings against the company for using cattle feed bran in the manufacture of Priyagold biscuits, along with other serious violations.Citing FSSAI’s notice, Nepal's food department decided to prohibit the biscuits from entering or being sold in the country. The decision was taken during an emergency meeting held virtually at the initiative of department director general Sanjeev Kumar Karna.The department said that the restrictions were imposed with human health security and consumer welfare in mind.Following the ban, the FTQCD has asked relevant bodies, traders and consumers to refrain from importing Priyagold biscuits and ensure that their sale and distribution are stopped.It has also directed authorised importers and food traders to immediately recall any stocks of the biscuits that may still be available in the market.You use AI every day. articles.title: Apple India crosses Rs 1 lakh crore revenue in FY26 as growth accelerates 31% and profit jumps 66% to Rs 5,311 crore; iPhone volumes rise 24%
articles.summary: Apple is growing big in India with its business crossing the Rs 1 lakh crore revenue mark in FY2026.
articles.body: Apple is growing big in India with its business crossing the Rs 1 lakh crore revenue mark in FY2026. Both sales and profits grew at a faster pace than the previous year. The performance came even as the broader market slowed, reflecting continued demand for the company's products, particularly its iPhones.Apple India Pvt Ltd reported revenue from operations of Rs 1,03,853 crore for the year ended March 2026, which is a 31% increase from Rs 79,060 crore in FY25.The figures are based on company filings with the Registrar of Companies accessed through business intelligence platform AltInfo. Samsung, Apple's biggest competitor in the Indian market, reported a 1.4% fall in mobile phone revenue to Rs 81,472 crore in the last fiscal year, according to an ET report.Apple's revenue growth in India also picked up considerably from the 18% expansion recorded in the previous financial year.The increase in profitability outpaced revenue growth. Apple's India net profit climbed 66% to Rs 5,311 crore in FY26, compared with Rs 3,196 crore a year earlier. In FY25, profit had grown by 16%.The company's filings did not explain what drove the sharper growth in revenue and earnings. Apple India had not responded to an email seeking comment by press time on Monday.Analysing trendsCounterpoint data shows that India's smartphone market expanded 2% in volume terms and 9% in value terms in FY26. Phones priced above Rs 30,000 recorded the strongest growth among market segments, with volumes rising 12%. Apple's own volume growth more than doubled, reaching 24% in FY26 from 11% in the preceding financial year."Apple's growth in India is being driven by the steady shift towards premium smartphones. Strong brand aspiration, wider retail reach, deeper distribution across tier-2 and beyond markets, along with easy financing options are making iPhones accessible to a much larger set of buyers," Shubham Singh, research analyst at Counterpoint Technology Market Research told ET.Singh said Apple is benefiting from the shrinking price difference between iPhones and premium Android handsets at a time when smartphone prices across brands have risen. Apple's stronger brand appeal and tightly integrated ecosystem are helping it capitalize on this trend.Apple's strong showing comes even as competition between it and Samsung has intensified in India. Both companies have reported revenues of a comparable scale, although the businesses covered by their respective figures differ considerably.Samsung Electronics India recorded revenue of Rs 1.12 lakh crore in FY26. However, its operations span several categories beyond smartphones, including televisions, household appliances and telecom network equipment, as well as exports. Despite its broader portfolio, Samsung's domestic smartphone business registered a slight decline.Apple India's reported revenue, on the other hand, does not reflect the entire scale of iPhone production and exports originating in India.These exports are handled by Apple's contract manufacturers, with the resulting sales recorded through multiple overseas entities within the Apple group rather than being accounted for in Apple India's books.You use AI every day. articles.title: India-New Zealand FTA kicks in: Zero duty, more opportunities - what's in it for India?
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: The India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement (FTA) came into force on Tuesday opening up new opportunities for Indian exporters, manufacturers,
articles.body: NEW DELHI: The India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement (FTA) came into force on Tuesday opening up new opportunities for Indian exporters, manufacturers, farmers, professionals and businesses. The agreement provides 100% duty-free access to the New Zealand market for all Indian export tariff lines, removing peak tariffs of up to 10%.Signed on April 27, 2026, the pact aims to deepen economic ties between the two countries and double bilateral trade in goods and services to NZ$7 billion (Rs 35,000 crore) by 2030. Negotiations were launched on March 16, 2025, and concluded on December 22, 2025, within nine months.The agreement is India's 17th operational FTA and the seventh trade pact to come into force in the past five years. It covers goods, services, investment, agriculture, skills and mobility, while retaining safeguards for sensitive sectors.What's in it for India?1. Duty-free access for Indian exportersAll Indian goods can enter New Zealand duty-free, giving Indian exporters a competitive advantage and placing them on a level playing field with New Zealand's other FTA partners. Textiles, apparel, leather, footwear, gems and jewellery, engineering goods, automobiles and auto components, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, agricultural products and processed foods are among the sectors expected to benefit.Duty-free access for wooden logs, coking coal and metal waste and scrap will strengthen manufacturing and MSME supply chains. Streamlined regulatory processes are expected to benefit pharmaceutical and medical device industries.2. A boost for MSMEs and small businessesThe agreement opens New Zealand's market to micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs), women-led businesses, start-ups, artisans and first-generation entrepreneurs.Zero duties and faster customs processes are expected to reduce landed costs and help Indian businesses expand their customer base. Cooperation will improve access to trade-related information and links with New Zealand's small and medium enterprise ecosystem, with particular attention to businesses owned by women and young people.New Zealand has also committed to facilitating the registration of Indian geographical indications (GIs), creating opportunities to protect products associated with rural artisans and traditional industries.3. New opportunities for farmersThe Agricultural Productivity Partnership will bring technology, training and global best practices to Indian agriculture, extending cooperation beyond tariff concessions.Dedicated action plans for apples, kiwifruit and honey will support better orchard management, reduce post-harvest losses and improve productivity and farm incomes. Cooperation will also cover horticulture, forestry, livestock and fisheries.New Zealand will provide technical assistance to establish Centres of Excellence for kiwifruit, apples and honey. Phase I sites for kiwifruit centres have been identified at Pfutsero in Nagaland and Magra in Uttarakhand. Two apple centres are proposed in Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand, while honey centres are envisaged in Uttar Pradesh and West Bengal.Tariff rate quotas for apples, kiwifruit and Mānuka honey are linked to the delivery of action plans and overseen by a Joint Agriculture Productivity Council, linking market access with farmer welfare.4. More opportunities for Indian professionals and studentsNew Zealand has offered market access in around 118 services sectors and Most-Favoured-Nation commitments in about 139 sub-sectors, its most extensive services offered under any trade agreement to date.For the first time, dedicated access has been provided for health and traditional medicine services, including Ayurveda, yoga and other AYUSH systems.Indian youth and professionals will have access to 5,000 Temporary Employment Entry visas and 1,000 Working Holiday visas annually.There will be no numerical cap on Indian students. Post-study work rights will extend to three years for STEM bachelor's and master's graduates and up to four years for doctoral scholars.5. Investment, manufacturing and employmentNew Zealand has committed to facilitating $20 billion in investment into India over more than 15 years.The investment is expected to benefit agriculture, manufacturing, infrastructure and start-ups, supporting innovation, entrepreneurship and employment generation under the Make in India vision.Provisions covering duty-free inputs, bilateral cumulation, customs facilitation and investment promotion could encourage deeper integration into value chains and improve investment conditions.6. Safeguards for sensitive Indian sectorsDairy, sugar, edible oils and key agricultural commodities remain excluded from concessions to protect farmers, dairy producers, fisherfolk and rural communities.Rules of Origin, a bilateral safeguard mechanism and anti-circumvention provisions aim to ensure that benefits reach genuine Indian exporters.7. A larger trade partnershipBilateral trade fell about 11% to $1.15 billion in 2025-26, from $1.3 billion in the previous fiscal year. India's exports stood at $566.51 million, while imports were $589.1 million, leaving a trade deficit of $22.59 million.The FTA seeks to reverse the limited scale of trade and expand economic engagement. The first-ever export of a JCB machine from India to New Zealand was flagged off at the entry-into-force ceremony, with further product flag-offs planned across agriculture, gems and jewellery, engineering, sporting goods, footwear and leather.Commerce minister Piyush Goyal said that the agreement would create opportunities for exporters, particularly MSMEs, artisans, farmers and women entrepreneurs. The pact also supports India's strategic partnership with New Zealand and the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047, with its success ultimately depending on businesses converting improved market access into actual trade and investment.You use AI every day.
